 Dina Bin Ychuda

Hebrew University named Professor Dina Ben•Yehuda as the first female dean of its Faculty of Medicine. Ben•Yehuda. director of hematology at the Hadassah University Medical
Center for the past 15 years, began her tenure as HU's 23rd dean of the medical faculty on October 1. A former researcher at the Center for Cancer Research at Memorial SloanKettering Hospital in New York. her area of expertise focuses on malignant hematological diseases. including the innovative use of nanoparticles in treatment of malignant cells.
